summary: Jenkinsfile.promote records a tagless prd tip as release-<this build> without moving prd or retagging. A tagged tip still refuses, and every other path is unchanged. Jenkins' linter parses the new ternary. One advisory: the recovery re-run must name the stuck commit, because main moves several times a day.

findings.summary: A recovery re-run with an empty commit, after Build-Main moves main, promotes the new tip and leaves the stuck release unrecordable by the job; the doc phase must state commit=<sha>
